title: Aoyagi Toya — Turning Excitement Into Words〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe we get to see COL again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can't either.
We owe you big, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I didn't do anything.
You should be thanking Taiga for actually getting a hold of the owner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you were the one who asked him about this place. We wouldn't be here if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's right, so thank you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So what's COL like?
Is it different from other live houses?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is it really big or something? There were lots of people there, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've only heard bits and pieces from Akito...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you settle down and give them a chance to answer, Len?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we can tell you guys all about it, but it really wasn't that different from any other live house.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you're gonna get to see it for yourself, so why not just wait instead of inflating your expectations?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree since you'll be joining us on this little excursion.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nooo! I won't be able to sleep from all this excitement!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, please try to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More importantly, I'd like to learn more about what RAD WEEKEND was really like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The only solid piece of information I have at this point is that the event An's dad put on was unlike anything else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What it was really like...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember asking Akito the same thing when we first formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, it was more like I monologued while you sat there to listen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seemed very eager to tell someone about how great it was.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Gimme a break...
Everyone else I talked to about this would listen but laugh at me once I was done.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If that's the case, Akito, can you tell us what you told Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but you'll only get to hear about what happened from my perspective.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's totally fine! I wanna hear too actually!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been a while, so I'd like to hear it again as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'll talk.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, Len, I've already told you both a little about how I used to play soccer until I was a sixth grader and quit after burning out...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I was introduced to music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My sister took me to the Summer Festival that year to see the show they were putting on, and I was hooked...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The Summer Festival?
Didn't you and Toya sing there this year?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was hard to believe that I'd be performing on the stage that I saw all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, you weren't exactly interested in performing at first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It was my sister's idea.
She casually suggested I do it in passing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But singing without really meaning it isn't my thing. Also, it wouldn't have been good for the event...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so thoughtful of you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That passion and thoughtfulness of yours may be the reason why you got to go to RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Call it karma or whatever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm really glad I ended up going...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's great, so what was the show like?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Back then, I had no idea who anyone on stage was since I knew next to nothing about street music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But they had me hook, line and sinker from the first song...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I couldn't take my eyes off them as they threw me into a sea of music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't know anyone in the crowd either, but in the heat of the moment, it felt like we were all old friends shouting our lungs out together...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I knew I was witnessing something special... Something legendary...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said! I was shouting like crazy with everyone else too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once it was all over, I thought, “I wanna do something like this too.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had zero musical knowledge, but I felt compelled to start practicing that day because of how it sent these shockwaves through me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Like now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: D-Did I sound that excited?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More than usual at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I suppose this could be considered normal since RAD WEEKEND is what's driving you. Plus, you always seem to have fun talking about it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It just means that much to you, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it does.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Until now, all I had to work with was what Akito felt that night...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But actually seeing COL... Seeing where it happened might give me a better insight.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You feeling it now, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe I have a better understanding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to visiting COL now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! You and me both!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed.
